name: qfd_static_selector_fork26

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL captures each a bit in independent b0/b1 flops on the same edge; outputs are these actual FFs. Reset pin captures in one FF. Adding generic boundary registers would change the proved one-edge compiled command/selector latency.

job.purpose: NEW actual 26bit registered fork: exact one-edge independently registered outputs, source-bound balanced static tree; native clock/pin/TTFFDRC gate required before die adoption

structural_change: Actual first gate identified pin-anchor pack failure: packed4um IO bands cannot hold output FF plus BUF/HB2/BUF and inputhold FIRM stations. Spread all data bits across available faces and grow core for measured source cells plus actual hold/clock cells; preserve actual same-edge RTL copies.
